tables.name: product_costs
tables.description: Cost history: what each product costs from its supplier, from a given date until the next row.

tables.name: invoices
tables.description: One invoice per completed order.

tables.name: payments
tables.description: Payments received. An invoice with no payment row is still outstanding.

tables.name: expenses
tables.description: Operating expenses by month, category and region (not cost of goods).

columns.name: category
columns.description: Salaries, Marketing, Logistics, Rent or Software

tables.name: budgets
tables.description: Monthly plan by region. Category 'Revenue' is the revenue target; other categories are expense budgets.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Revenue, Salaries, Marketing, Logistics, Rent or Software

tables.name: fx_rates
tables.description: Monthly currency rates.

columns.name: rate_to_usd
columns.description: USD per one unit of the currency

metrics.name: revenue
metrics.definition: Net revenue from completed orders after discounts, in USD.

metrics.name: gross_margin
metrics.definition: (revenue - cost of goods sold) / revenue.

metrics.name: operating_margin
metrics.definition: (revenue - cost of goods sold - operating expenses) / revenue, for the same period and region. Operating expenses come from analytics.expenses.
metrics.sql: (SUM(gross_profit_usd) - <SUM(amount_usd) FROM analytics.expenses for the same months>) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_usd), 0)

metrics.name: discount_rate
metrics.definition: Discount given as a share of revenue before discount.

metrics.name: dso
metrics.definition: Days sales outstanding: average days from invoice issue to payment, over invoices paid in the period. Unpaid invoices are not included; report them separately as outstanding.
metrics.sql: AVG(p.paid_date - i.issued_date) FROM analytics.invoices i JOIN analytics.payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.id

metrics.name: overdue
metrics.definition: An invoice is overdue when its due date has passed (relative to the last day of data) and it has no payment. Report overdue invoices by count and amount alongside any days-late figure.
metrics.sql: FROM analytics.invoices i LEFT JOIN analytics.payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.id WHERE p.id IS NULL AND i.due_date < DATE '2026-09-30'

metrics.name: days_late
metrics.definition: Days between the due date and the payment date (negative means paid early).
